rulesStrings.li: r_title->Timber for [SETTLEMENT]
r_title->Clearing work at [SETTLEMENT]
r_title->Woodcutters wanted
r_flavor->[sb_opener] [sb_need] [sb_closer]
sb_opener->A storm took down half the old stand near [SETTLEMENT].
sb_opener->[SETTLEMENT] has run through its firewood and building timber.
sb_opener->The foresters of [SETTLEMENT] have fallen behind on their cutting.
sb_need->They need strong hands to fell, trim and stack the logs.
sb_need->They are looking for workers who know trees and can be trusted with an axe.
sb_need->They want a steady crew to clear the stand before the wood spoils.
sb_closer->Pay is promised on completion.
sb_closer->The work is hard but honest, and the reward is fixed in advance.
r_title->Builders needed in [SETTLEMENT]
r_title->Repairs at [SETTLEMENT]
r_title->Workshop raising
r_flavor->[sb_opener] [sb_need] [sb_closer]
sb_opener->[SETTLEMENT] is raising new walls and cannot find enough skilled builders.
sb_opener->Winter damage has left several buildings in [SETTLEMENT] close to collapse.
sb_opener->A new workshop is half built in [SETTLEMENT], and the master builder has fallen ill.
sb_need->They will pay for a capable builder to lead the work, and for hands to follow.
sb_need->They need people who can read a plan and lay stone straight.
sb_need->They are asking for experienced hands to finish the frame and roof.
sb_closer->Materials are provided; only labour is wanted.
sb_closer->The payment is held in trust until the job is done.
r_title->Healers wanted
r_title->Sickbeds at [SETTLEMENT]
r_title->Relief medics for [SETTLEMENT]
r_flavor->[sb_opener] [sb_need] [sb_closer]
sb_opener->A fever is moving through [SETTLEMENT] and its healers are exhausted.
sb_opener->There were injuries after an accident in [SETTLEMENT], and the sickbeds are full.
sb_opener->[SETTLEMENT] has more patients than hands to tend them.
sb_need->They want someone with real medical training to take over the wards for a time.
sb_need->They are looking for steady caregivers who can treat and nurse without supervision.
sb_need->They need medics who will keep their patients alive until the crisis passes.
sb_closer->The pay is good for the short engagement.
sb_closer->Medicine and bandages will be supplied.
r_title->Expedition from [SETTLEMENT]
r_title->Guides and guards wanted
r_title->Provisioning the survey party
r_flavor->[sb_opener] [sb_need] [sb_closer]
sb_opener->[SETTLEMENT] is sending an expedition into the wilds and wants experienced company.
sb_opener->A survey party from [SETTLEMENT] is short of guides, guards and foragers.
sb_opener->The leaders of [SETTLEMENT] are organising a long trek and need dependable help.
sb_need->They need a mix of talents: someone to handle the animals, someone to guard the line, someone to find food.
sb_need->They will pay well for a small, capable party with the right mix of skills.
sb_need->They want people who can keep beasts calm, shoot straight and forage when supplies run low.
sb_closer->The party will be gone for several days.
sb_closer->The reward is secured at [SETTLEMENT] until they return.
r_title->Quarry hands for [SETTLEMENT]
r_title->Stonecutters wanted
r_title->Clearing the quarry face
r_flavor->[sb_opener] [sb_need] [sb_closer]
sb_opener->The quarry outside [SETTLEMENT] has a backlog of stone that nobody has had time to cut.
sb_opener->[SETTLEMENT] needs more building stone than its own quarrymen can cut.
sb_opener->The working face at the quarry of [SETTLEMENT] is choked with rubble.
sb_need->They want workers who can dig safely, cut clean blocks and carry them out from the face.
sb_need->They are looking for steady hands who know how to read rock and work it without waste.
sb_need->They need the loose stone cleared and the good stone hauled out in an orderly fashion.
sb_closer->The promised reward is held for the end of the work.
sb_closer->It is dusty work of a few days, and the pay is set in advance.
r_title->Cooks needed at [SETTLEMENT]
r_title->Kitchen help wanted
r_title->Meals for a full house
r_flavor->[sb_opener] [sb_need] [sb_closer]
sb_opener->The kitchens of [SETTLEMENT] are crowded after a run of new arrivals.
sb_opener->[SETTLEMENT] has more mouths to feed than its cooks can manage.
sb_opener->The head cook of [SETTLEMENT] has more orders than hands.
sb_need->They want cooks who can turn out quick, clean meals without wasting the larder.
sb_need->They are looking for people who know their way around a stove and a stockpot.
sb_need->They need meals prepared steadily and kept coming until the rush is over.
sb_closer->The work is short, and the reward is promised on completion.
sb_closer->Ingredients are supplied; only skill and time are wanted.
r_title->Clothing order at [SETTLEMENT]
r_title->Tailors wanted
r_title->A rush of cloth and thread
r_flavor->[sb_opener] [sb_need] [sb_closer]
sb_opener->[SETTLEMENT] has an urgent order of clothing to deliver and too few tailors.
sb_opener->Cold weather is coming, and the people of [SETTLEMENT] are short of warm garments.
sb_opener->Travelers are expected at [SETTLEMENT], and the order for their apparel is far behind.
sb_need->They want workers who can cut and sew the cloth they have supplied.
sb_need->They are looking for steady hands with needle and shears to finish the order on time.
sb_need->They need garments finished well and finished quickly.
sb_closer->Materials are provided; only labour is wanted.
sb_closer->The reward is fixed in advance and paid when the order is done.
r_title->A monument for [SETTLEMENT]
r_title->Artisans wanted for a memorial
r_title->Commission for a public work
r_flavor->[sb_opener] [sb_need] [sb_closer]
sb_opener->The people of [SETTLEMENT] want a public monument to mark their history.
sb_opener->A memorial is planned in [SETTLEMENT], but no one there has the skill to shape it.
sb_opener->The council of [SETTLEMENT] has promised its people a fine piece of public art.
sb_need->They want an artist to design and shape the work and, where needed, a builder to set it in place.
sb_need->They are looking for someone with a real eye for form who can see the monument through.
sb_need->They need skilled hands to give the work a worthy shape.
sb_closer->The promised reward is paid once the commission is finished.
sb_closer->The commission will take several days of careful work.
r_title->Merchant talks at [SETTLEMENT]
r_title->Envoys wanted
r_title->Mediators for the market
r_flavor->[sb_opener] [sb_need] [sb_closer]
sb_opener->Trade terms between the merchants of [SETTLEMENT] have stalled.
sb_opener->A dispute over weights and prices has soured the market at [SETTLEMENT].
sb_opener->The merchants of [SETTLEMENT] cannot agree and will not hear each other out.
sb_need->They want a patient negotiator who can bargain and keep the peace.
sb_need->They are looking for someone persuasive and fair to broker an agreement.
sb_need->They need a calm voice to hear both sides and settle the matter.
sb_closer->The reward is promised once terms are agreed.
sb_closer->The talks should take only a few days.
r_title->Records to untangle
r_title->Scribes and scholars wanted
r_title->Ledgers of [SETTLEMENT]
r_flavor->[sb_opener] [sb_need] [sb_closer]
sb_opener->The ledgers of [SETTLEMENT] are damaged and no longer agree with one another.
sb_opener->Years of records at [SETTLEMENT] have been left in disorder.
sb_opener->Conflicting accounts have left the keepers of [SETTLEMENT] unable to settle a long argument.
sb_need->They want a careful reader who can catalog the records and compare what they say.
sb_need->They are looking for sharp minds to sort the evidence and make sense of it.
sb_need->They need the records put in order and their meaning worked out.
sb_closer->The reward is held until the findings are handed over.
sb_closer->It is slow, careful work of several days.
r_title->Watch rotation at [SETTLEMENT]
r_title->Guards wanted
r_title->Reinforcing the watch
r_flavor->[sb_opener] [sb_need] [sb_closer]
sb_opener->The guards of [SETTLEMENT] are tired after many nights on watch.
sb_opener->The watch at [SETTLEMENT] is short-handed and the rotation is wearing thin.
sb_opener->Word of trouble in the area has left [SETTLEMENT] anxious about its perimeter.
sb_need->They want dependable people to patrol the edge of the settlement and stand ready to defend it.
sb_need->They are looking for guards who can keep watch and answer a threat at a distance or up close.
sb_need->They need steady hands to relieve the weary guards for a time.
sb_closer->The promised reward is paid when the rotation ends.
sb_closer->The watch will last a few days, and the pay is fixed in advance.
r_title->Herders wanted
r_title->Livestock drive from [SETTLEMENT]
r_title->Hands for the herds
r_flavor->[sb_opener] [sb_need] [sb_closer]
sb_opener->The herds of [SETTLEMENT] must be moved to fresh ground.
sb_opener->[SETTLEMENT] has more animals than its herders can manage.
sb_opener->The herders of [SETTLEMENT] are short-handed at the busiest part of the season.
sb_need->They want people who can handle animals, keep them calm and keep the herd together.
sb_need->They are looking for experienced hands who understand beasts and how to move them.
sb_need->They need the animals driven, watered and kept in good order.
sb_closer->The reward is fixed in advance and paid on completion.
sb_closer->The drive should take a few days.
r_title->Bring in the harvest
r_title->Harvest help at [SETTLEMENT]
r_title->Fields and kitchens at [SETTLEMENT]
r_flavor->[sb_opener] [sb_need] [sb_closer]
sb_opener->A crop at [SETTLEMENT] is ripe and in danger of spoiling before it is gathered.
sb_opener->The harvest at [SETTLEMENT] is bigger than the settlement can handle in time.
sb_opener->The fields of [SETTLEMENT] have given a good yield, but the work to save it has not been done.
sb_need->They want hands to gather the crop and cooks to prepare it for storage.
sb_need->They are looking for workers who can bring in a harvest and make it keep.
sb_need->They need the crop gathered quickly and the food made ready for the stores.
sb_closer->The reward is promised once the work is done.
sb_closer->It is a few days of busy work, and the pay is set in advance.
r_title->Cave-in relief at [SETTLEMENT]
r_title->Diggers and healers wanted
r_title->Trapped in the tunnels
r_flavor->[sb_opener] [sb_need] [sb_closer]
sb_opener->A tunnel has collapsed near [SETTLEMENT] and the passage is blocked.
sb_opener->A cave-in has left several workers of [SETTLEMENT] hurt and cut off.
sb_opener->The miners of [SETTLEMENT] cannot clear the fallen rock and tend their wounded at once.
sb_need->They want careful diggers to clear the way and skilled hands to tend the injured.
sb_need->They are looking for people who can shift rubble carefully and give medical care.
sb_need->They need the passage opened and the hurt looked after as quickly as possible.
sb_closer->The promised reward is paid once the work is done.
sb_closer->Time is short, and the pay is fixed in advance.
r_title->Hunters wanted
r_title->Game for [SETTLEMENT]
r_title->A hunt for the stores
r_flavor->[sb_opener] [sb_need] [sb_closer]
sb_opener->The larders of [SETTLEMENT] are running low and the hunters cannot keep up.
sb_opener->Game has been seen near [SETTLEMENT], and the settlement wants it brought in.
sb_opener->[SETTLEMENT] is short of meat and short of people who can hunt.
sb_need->They want sharp-eyed hunters who can track game and bring it down cleanly.
sb_need->They are looking for steady shots who can hunt without wasting the kill.
sb_need->They need game brought in and dressed before the meat spoils.
sb_closer->The reward is promised once the hunt is over.
sb_closer->The hunt should last a few days, and the pay is set in advance.
r_title->Herbs for the healers
r_title->Gatherers wanted at [SETTLEMENT]
r_title->Medicinal plants needed
r_flavor->[sb_opener] [sb_need] [sb_closer]
sb_opener->The healers of [SETTLEMENT] have used up their stock of medicinal plants.
sb_opener->A fever is spreading near [SETTLEMENT], and the herbalists cannot gather enough to treat it.
sb_opener->The wild herbs around [SETTLEMENT] are ready to pick, but nobody has the time.
sb_need->They want people who can find the right plants and others who know how to prepare them.
sb_need->They are looking for gatherers with a steady hand and healers who can make use of the harvest.
sb_need->They need the plants picked carefully and made ready for the sick.
sb_closer->The reward is paid when the work is done.
sb_closer->It is a short job, and the pay is fixed in advance.
r_title->Pens and fences at [SETTLEMENT]
r_title->Builders and animal hands wanted
r_title->Mending the animal pens
r_flavor->[sb_opener] [sb_need] [sb_closer]
sb_opener->The animal pens of [SETTLEMENT] were damaged and the stock is loose.
sb_opener->The sheds and fences of [SETTLEMENT] are falling apart, and the animals are restless.
sb_opener->[SETTLEMENT] is building new pens and needs help to finish them and fill them.
sb_need->They want builders to mend the fences and hands who can keep the animals calm meanwhile.
sb_need->They are looking for people who can drive posts and settle nervous animals.
sb_need->They need the pens made sound and the animals put back safely.
sb_closer->Materials are provided, and the pay is fixed in advance.
sb_closer->The reward is paid once the animals are settled.
r_title->Teachers wanted
r_title->Lessons at [SETTLEMENT]
r_title->A tutor for the young
r_flavor->[sb_opener] [sb_need] [sb_closer]
sb_opener->The only teacher of [SETTLEMENT] has left, and the young have nobody to learn from.
sb_opener->[SETTLEMENT] has more apprentices than its elders have time to teach.
sb_opener->The people of [SETTLEMENT] want their children taught more than they can teach themselves.
sb_need->They want a learned person who can explain things clearly and hold a class together.
sb_need->They are looking for patient teachers who can share what they know.
sb_need->They need lessons given for a few days, in whatever way the teacher sees fit.
sb_closer->The reward is fixed in advance and paid when the lessons end.
sb_closer->It is a quiet job, and payment is promised on completion.
r_title->Festival preparations at [SETTLEMENT]
r_title->Hands for the feast
r_title->Cooks and entertainers wanted
r_flavor->[sb_opener] [sb_need] [sb_closer]
sb_opener->[SETTLEMENT] is holding a festival and the preparations have fallen behind.
sb_opener->A feast is coming to [SETTLEMENT], and the organisers are short of help.
sb_opener->The people of [SETTLEMENT] want a celebration to remember, but have too few hands to arrange it.
sb_need->They want skilled hands to help make the festival a success.
sb_need->They are looking for a mixed company with the talents a good celebration calls for.
sb_need->They need everything ready before the guests arrive.
sb_closer->The reward is promised once the festival is ready.
sb_closer->The work takes a few days, and the pay is fixed in advance.
